publication_policy: Noether is at the Zenodo 100-file ceiling. Fold these targeted source-patch packages into the next compact current-control/source-audit rebalance rather than loose-uploading them above reader PDFs/current TeX.
quality_scope: Targeted Paper 24 source-patch support only. These packages do not certify Paper 24, the Noether corpus, multilingual synchronization, source closure, or a critical edition.
source_quality_caveat: Both packages use GDZ Math. Ann. 90 native400 full-page witnesses plus enlarged labelled readability crops. Native400 is useful for the recorded loci but below the preferred native650+ target for dense global certification.

packages.source_scope: Paper 24 printed pp.231-233, GDZ Math. Ann. 90 native400 full-page images plus enlarged labelled crops.
packages.tex_result: Applies one source-visible German cumulative correction and builds a 471-page cumulative German PDF with XeLaTeX.

confirmed_fixes.description: Restores the source exponent notation in the phrase p^g-te Potenz (g >= 0), replacing the stale p^f / f > 0 reading.

no_fix_traps: Printed pp.232-233 transformed-range/barred/fraktur notation was left for a source-style typography pass rather than normalized blindly.
Equation layout/tag punctuation around formulas (1) and (1') was not globally rewritten.
Formula (2) was treated as semantically close but not source-style certified.

packages.source_scope: Paper 24 printed pp.234-236, GDZ Math. Ann. 90 native400 full-page images plus enlarged labelled crops.
packages.tex_result: Applies three source-visible German cumulative corrections and builds a 471-page cumulative German PDF with XeLaTeX.

confirmed_fixes.description: Restores the product line so R^(i) begins with E^(i), not E_0^(i).
Restores the Q_lambda norm-equality display; the stale version had an incorrect congruence condition.
Restores formula (5)'s source factorization with barred variables in the linear term and exponent lambda_nu.

no_fix_traps: Old fraktur/congruence notation was not globally modernized.
The finite-chain example style and indices remain for a fuller source-style typography pass.
